CA.rationale: Content identified and processing-origin evidence present, but processing/attention relation is not explicitly described as attention/allocation (ambiguous).

COD.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (red coordinates), its presentation/access origin, and thus distinguishes content from presentation/status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Processing-origin labels present but no explicit statement that these are attention/allocation conditions; functional processing is implied but not clearly linked as an attention/allocation claim.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (coloured items at coordinates) are listed for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an explicit origin/presentation status for the same referent/time, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The report describes how contents are represented/presented via origin/status tags for current items and via explicit candidate organizational patterns.
